title: Youngjun Park
text:
Introduction
Hello! I’m Youngjun Park, an urban researcher and architect.
Based on my knowledge in architecture and urban design, I explore rational and evidence-based urban research and design using data science techniques.
Currently, I work as a partner architect at AR-GE Architects, participating in research and development of architectural/urban design solutions using Agentic AI.
Learn more about me | View my research | Explore design projects

Current Position: Partner Architect at AR-GE Architects Email: youngjourpark@gmail.com Location: Daejeon, South Korea
